## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`…).
- [ ] Code, comments and commit messages are in English; UI text lives in `src/i18n`.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] New statistics or sources come with tests on synthetic exports.
- [ ] No real chat export is included.
